Part II. Listen to a conversation between Nam and Lan. Choose the best answer A, B, C or D. You will hear the recording twice.
Lan: Hi, Duy. Are you new here?
Duy: Yes, I am. This is my first week at this school.
Lan: How do you go to school?
Duy: I ride my bicycle to school every morning.
Lan: What is your favourite subject?
Duy: I like maths best because it is interesting.
Lan: What do you do at break time?
Duy: I play football with my classmates.
Lan: Do you like the new school?
Duy: Yes. The teachers are nice and helpful, and my classmates are friendly.
Now listen again
Lan: Hi, Duy. Are you new here?
Duy: Yes, I am. This is my first week at this school.
Lan: How do you go to school?
Duy: I ride my bicycle to school every morning.
Lan: What is your favourite subject?
Duy: I like maths best because it is interesting.
Lan: What do you do at break time?
Duy: I play football with my classmates.
Lan: Do you like the new school?
Duy: Yes. The teachers are nice and helpful, and my classmates are friendly.
